input_equivalence: New question-only projection; not a published original Mulder prompt. Supplying this list changes the historical autonomous-investigation input.

questions.prompt: Identify the suspect user and associated email identity. Cite the evidence for attribution.
Identify the PC operating-system version, edition, architecture, and domain or workgroup configuration.
Identify removable device RM1: manufacturer, model, device serial number, filesystem, and volume label.
Identify removable device RM2: manufacturer, model, device serial number, filesystem, and volume label.
Identify RM3 media type and filesystem. Report relevant recorded creation or format timestamps, their time zones, and what the source timestamps mean.
Identify the project documents present on USB media. Report filenames, sizes, locations, and evidence for any transfer conclusion.
Investigate filename or extension masquerading on RM2. Enumerate recoverable disguised files and supported original-to-renamed mappings.
Identify anti-forensic applications and evidence of their download, installation, execution, or removal.
Report relevant search-history evidence and state what conclusions about planning it supports. Label inferences.
Report cloud synchronization applications, their installation or execution evidence, and evidence for any data-transfer conclusion.
Report additional cloud-service installer downloads or executions and the evidence for their possible role.
Report USB connection timestamps, associate each event with its device, and identify the event-log or other source.
Reconstruct the timeline of project-document copies onto USB media, including the bounds and sources of any bulk-copy interval.
For identified cleanup software, distinguish installation and launch from actions actually performed. Cite evidence for any claimed artifact destruction or absence of action.
Investigate deletion of files on RM2. Report the affected filesystem, files, timing, and time-zone interpretation.
Enumerate recoverable RM3 documents and explain supported relationships to project documents on the other evidence media.
List the files opened or accessed on RM2 and cite evidence that links each access to that device.
Identify network shares and directories traversed. Cite evidence and relevant access times.
Reconstruct relevant email communications, including correspondents and messages supported by the evidence.
Explain FAT filesystem timestamp interpretation relative to UTC and the case time zone. Apply any supported offset consistently.
